summary: One-off custom kits for football tournaments: a jersey for the weekend, ordered in time for the date, for one team or the whole competition.
content:
Quick answer

For a football tournament — a weekend cup, a charity event, a work five-a-side — MOMUTO makes one-off custom kits with your colours and logo, full dye-sublimation, no minimum order. Draft in 24–48 h, delivery in 25–30 days.

A one-off kit for the weekend

A tournament deserves its own kit, not borrowed bibs. Design a one-off jersey with a name, a date and a sponsor — from the free 3D configurator or a custom design.

Order in time for the date

A tournament has a fixed date, so work back from it: 25–30 days for production and delivery, plus a day or two to validate the design. See when to order.

One team or the whole competition

No minimum order means you can kit a single team, or supply matching sets in different colours for every side in the competition. Size guide.

Frequently asked questions

How quickly can we get tournament kits?

Allow 25–30 days from order to delivery. Order at least five weeks before the tournament date to be safe.

Can we print the tournament name and date?

Yes — name, date, logo and sponsors are printed into the fabric by sublimation, at no extra cost.

Can you supply every team in the tournament?

Yes. There is no minimum order, so you can order matching sets in different colours for each side.
